sudo.title: Use Sudo
sudo.description: Use Sudo (sudo needed to the target hostname)

rdiff-backup-version.title: Remote rdiff-backup Major Version
rdiff-backup-version.description: Major version of rdiff-backup running on the target hostname. The rdiff-backup network protocol is not compatible between major versions, so this must match the remote end exactly.

connection_port.title: Connection Port
connection_port.description: SSH port of the target hostname

remote_rdiff_path.title: Remote rdiff-backup Path
remote_rdiff_path.description: Path to the rdiff-backup binary on the target hostname, if not reachable as 'rdiff-backup' through the SSH login shell's PATH
